newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bahrain's BIB 1996 net profit up 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's BIB 1996 net profit up 16 pct.

text.p: Bahrain International Bank E.C. (BIB), an offshore banking unit, on Friday reported a new record net profit of $21.7 million for 1996, up 16 percent from the previous high of $18.7 million in 1995.
"The board of directors is recommending a cash dividend of 10 percent on paid-in capital to the bank's annual general meeting on March 1," chief executive Robin McIlvenny said in a statement.
The Bahrain-based bank said total assets increased to $640.77 million in 1996 from $599.6 million in 1995 while total liabilities rose to $441.01 million from $404.7 million in the previous year.
It said operating expenses increased by 8.4 percent to $10.46 million and general provisions were increased to 7.35 million from 1.0 million the previous year.
BIB, which was established in 1982, is an international investment bank with offices in Bahrain, the United States, London and Dublin.
